title: Standard gate operations have simple shapes
statement: Let $D$ be a type, and let $g$ be a gate with Boolean outputs whose operation is either the identity operation, a unary negation, or a conjunction of some arity. Then there is a shape built from a wire, a negated wire, or a conjunction of a list of elements of $D$ whose value agrees with the value of $g$ for every assignment of Boolean values to $D$.
hypotheses_covered: The operation of $g$ belongs to the specified standard gate set
